title: The Four-Step Singer Kitchens Process

steps.title: Let's Talk Kitchens
steps.lead: Every kitchen starts with a conversation.
body: Tell us what you're thinking about changing, what matters most, and what kind of timeline you have in mind.
We can begin discussing financing options during this first call and answer questions about cabinet availability.
If you need to move quickly, let us know. You may have more options than you think.

steps.title: Visit the Showroom
steps.lead: See and touch real cabinets, materials, finishes, and layouts.
body: Talk with a designer about your ideas, explore the possibilities, and continue discussing pricing and financing options.
You don't need to have everything figured out before you visit.

steps.title: In-Home Measurement
steps.lead: Accurate measurements help us understand your space and develop realistic design options and a custom quote.
body: We'll also discuss the practical details that could affect your project timeline.

steps.title: Design Consultation, Quote & Presentation
steps.lead: Meet with your designer to review the proposed design, custom pricing options, available financing, installation considerations, and next steps.
body: Our goal is to help you make informed decisions about your kitchen with a clear understanding of your options.
steps.summary: Our goal is to help you make informed decisions about your kitchen with a clear understanding of your options.
